prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Single high-fidelity visual direction comp for a native iPhone rail-departure app.
Primary request: Design one complete portrait iPhone app screen for “Last Train”, a one-handed after-dark rail departure tool. This is an in-app product UI mockup, not a marketing image.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 393×852-style portrait screen. No phone hardware frame, no device mockup, no environment, no poster treatment. Leave a clean, realistic iOS status and Dynamic Island safe area at the top.
Subject: A precision night-running instrument interface inspired by a black ceramic chronograph. Make the station context and rail direction unmistakable. Show a clear top mode control for LAST TRAIN and FAST TRAIN, with LAST TRAIN active. Show Upminster as the current station and EAST as the direction. Make 23:47 the monumental, dominant selected last-train departure to Shoeburyness. Wrap or accompany it with a precise luminous countdown/progress arc whose progress is visibly tied to that selected departure. Show smaller departure options 22:58, 23:18, and 23:32. Show FIRST BACK 05:12 and Direct services only as calm supporting information.
Style/medium: Production-grade ultra-modern native iOS UI. Refined, minimal, tactile, highly legible, feasible in SwiftUI. Precision industrial typography, crisp alignment, thoughtful optical spacing, subtle native interaction affordances. Avoid a generic card dashboard.
Composition/framing: Edge-to-edge screen capture, straight-on, portrait. Clear one-handed hierarchy: compact mode and journey context high on the screen, monumental selected departure in the thumb-friendly central region, supporting departures and first-back information below. No bottom tab bar. No decorative illustration.
Lighting/mood: After-dark, focused, quiet confidence; restrained luminosity and polished depth without flashy neon or sci-fi excess.
Color palette: #05080B near-black ground; #F4F7F9 primary text; #63FFD7 pulse mint for live progress and active controls; #66717C titanium details; #FF304C reserved exclusively for the LAST TRAIN state and nowhere else.
Materials/textures: Smoked sapphire glass layers, black ceramic surfaces, micro-etched titanium dividers and minute indices, extremely subtle controlled highlights. Keep surfaces understated and readable.
Text (verbatim): “LAST TRAIN”; “FAST TRAIN”; “Upminster”; “EAST”; “23:47”; “Shoeburyness”; “22:58”; “23:18”; “23:32”; “FIRST BACK 05:12”; “Direct services only”.
Constraints: Render every required text string exactly once and spell Upminster exactly. Preserve natural title casing for Upminster and Shoeburyness. Use no durations. Use no +1 notation, no next-day labels, no calendar-day labels, and no dates. Reserve red only for the active LAST TRAIN status; use mint for progress and current selection. Keep all content within native iOS safe areas and readable at phone scale.
Avoid: Phone hardware bezel or frame, hands, marketing poster, floating device, bottom tab bar, generic card grid, gratuitous glassmorphism, decorative train illustration, maps, photography, route maps, extra brand logos, fake notifications, tiny illegible copy, arbitrary labels, duration text, “+1”, “tomorrow”, calendar language, red accents outside LAST TRAIN.
